mentions.name: Open source security audit tool
mentions.description: This tool runs automated security audits on open source repositories, focusing on infrastructure projects such as vector databases, LLM tooling, and secrets managers. Findings are reported to maintainers via responsible disclosure, and fixes are autogenerated, with the author working on automating more of the test process.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Running security audits on open source repos with a tool we've built and reporting what I find to maintainers. Mostly infrastructure stuff — vector
databases, LLM tooling, secrets managers.
